description: This Java class defines a command 'ModifyFeature' used to modify an existing feature of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing feature details, and serializing the command payload.

classes.name: ModifyFeature
classes.description: A command class to modify an existing feature of a Thing, including JSON serialization/deserialization, size validation, and accessors.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ModifyFeature command with a ThingId, Feature, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyFeature command from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns the feature to be modified.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the feature as a JSON value according to schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the feature resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends command payload data to JSON builder with schema and predicate filtering.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization (false).
